tx-01.note: Direct antonyms for tobacco habits. 禁煙 금연 is refraining from smoking or designated smoke-free rules (금연 구역 non-smoking zone), whereas 吸煙 흡연 is the act of smoking (흡연실 smoking room).
Both mean visiting a sick person in the hospital, but 문병 (問病) is a concise Sino-Korean noun (문병을 가다), while 병문안 (病問安) is more conversational and expressive (친구 병문안을 다녀오다).
Sequential medical steps. 진찰 is the doctor examining and assessing symptoms (의사의 진찰 medical exam), whereas 치료 is administering medicine or surgery to heal the disease (치료를 받다 to receive treatment).

tx-02.note: 大便 feces or bodily waste (대변 검사 stool test) vs 代辯 speaking on behalf of a group or person (입장을 대변하다 to represent a stance, 대변인 spokesperson). Distinct hanja roots.
Paired clinical medical terms for bodily excretions. 소변 is liquid waste or urination (소변 검사 urine test), while 대변 is solid bowel movement (대변 검사 stool analysis).
Distinct medical conditions. 감기 is the mild common cold with runny nose and cough (감기에 걸리다). 독감 is severe influenza caused specifically by influenza viruses, requiring vaccination (독감 예방주사 flu shot).

tx-03.note: Two native Korean verbs: 붓다 ① for body tissue to swell up puffy (눈이 붓다 swollen eyes) vs 붓다 ② to pour liquid (물을 컵에 붓다 to pour water) vs 붓다 ③ to deposit savings installments (적금을 붓다).
癌 malignant cancer tumor (암 예방 cancer prevention) vs native prefix 암 meaning female of animals (암컷 female animal, 암사자 lioness). Unrelated origins sharing exact spelling.
軟膏 medical healing ointment or salve (피부 연고 skin ointment) vs 緣故 social or familial connections (연고가 없는 도시 a city with no personal ties). Distinct hanja roots.

tx-04.note: Direct antonyms for health and conditions. 나아지다 describes symptoms or circumstances improving (건강이 나아지다), whereas 나빠지다 describes them deteriorating (시력이 나빠지다).
Direct opposites for process continuity. 中斷 중단 is halting an ongoing project midway (공사 중단 construction halt), whereas 持續 지속 is maintaining progress without stopping (연구 지속 continuing research).
Both mean breaking, but 깨지다 specifically describes brittle materials like glass, mirrors, or porcelain cracking into sharp pieces (거울이 깨지다). 부서지다 describes solid objects crumbling under impact.

tx-05.note: Paired directional motion verbs. 따라가다 moves toward a destination away from the speaker (앞사람을 따라가다 to follow someone ahead), whereas 따라오다 moves in the direction toward the speaker (강아지가 나를 따라오다).
Direct opposites for project completion. 완성 describes a work brought to full fruition (작품 완성 artwork completion), while 미완성 describes unfinished pieces (미완성 교향곡 unfinished symphony).
Direct antonyms for ownership transfer. 뺏다 (빼앗다) is forcibly snatching or depriving someone of an item (물건을 뺏다), whereas 주다 is willingly offering or handing something over (선물을 주다).

tx-06.note: Core analytical pair in TOPIK essays. 공통점 highlights shared qualities between two subjects (두 문화의 공통점), whereas 차이점 highlights their distinctive differences (세대의 차이점).
Direct antonyms for relevance. 관계있다 links an event to an outcome (건강과 관계있다), whereas 관계없다 disclaims any connection (결과와 관계없다 has nothing to do with the result).
Direct antonyms for order. 규칙 denotes standard laws and regular rhythms (규칙적인 생활 regular lifestyle), whereas 불규칙 denotes erratic deviations (불규칙한 식습관 irregular eating habits).

tx-07.note: Direct antonyms for proficiency. 서투르다 describes unpracticed clumsiness in a skill (한국어가 서투르다 Korean is clumsy), whereas 능숙하다 describes polished proficiency (능숙한 솜씨 skillful hand).
Direct antonyms for statistical peaks and valleys. 최저 marks the absolute bottom floor (최저 임금 minimum wage), whereas 최고 marks the absolute top ceiling (역대 최고 기록 all-time high record).
Precise numerical boundary terms. 미만 means strictly below a number without including it (10세 미만 under 10, aged 9 and below), whereas 이상 includes the baseline number (10세 이상 aged 10 and above).

tx-08.note: Direct navigational and directional antonyms in signage. 우측 indicates the right flank (우측 통행 keep right), whereas 좌측 indicates the left flank (좌측 출구 left-hand exit).
Direct opposites for bilateral vs unilateral scope. 양쪽 refers to both flanks or mutual parties (양쪽 귀 both ears, 양쪽 입장 both stances), while 한쪽 isolates only one flank (한쪽 눈 one eye).
Two native noun uses: 송이 ① counting unit for flower blooms or grape bunches (꽃 한 송이 a single flower) vs 송이 ② abbreviation for the prized wild pine mushroom (송이버섯 matsutake mushroom).

tx-09.note: Direct geometric coordinate antonyms. 가로 measures horizontal width from left to right (가로 길이 width), while 세로 measures vertical height from top to bottom (세로 줄 vertical line).
Direct chromatic antonyms for native Korean color adjectives. 희다 describes pure white or pale surfaces (흰 눈 white snow), whereas 검다 describes deep black or darkness (검은 머리 black hair).
Direct sensory antonyms for physical texture. 단단하다 resists pressure and holds stiffly (단단한 돌 hard rock), whereas 부드럽다 yields easily and feels gentle (부드러운 빵 soft bread).

tx-10.note: Both mean manners, but 예의 is personal courtesy and respectful demeanor (예의 바른 태도 polite attitude), while 예절 refers to codified social rules and etiquette protocols (공공장소 예절 public etiquette).
祈禱 religious prayer or earnest wish (간절한 기도 earnest prayer) vs 氣道 anatomical respiratory airway (기도를 확보하다 to secure the airway in first aid). Distinct hanja roots.
매 ① hawk or falcon bird of prey (하늘을 나는 매) vs native 매 ② disciplinary rod or cane used for physical punishment (사랑의 매 cane of discipline). Unrelated origins sharing exact spelling.

tx-11.note: 설 Lunar New Year Day (설날 holiday) vs 說 academic theory or rumored explanation (새로운 학설 a new academic theory). Completely different origins.
龍 legendary dragon creature (하늘로 승천하는 용 dragon ascending to sky) vs suffix 用 meaning intended for use by a group (수출용 for export, 여성용 for women).
Contrasting life ceremonies in Korean culture. 예식장 is a wedding hall celebrating marriage (결혼 예식장), whereas 장례식 is a solemn funeral service mourning a death (장례식을 치르다).

tx-12.note: Distinct protective canopies. 陽傘 양산 shields from sunlight and heat on clear summer days (양산을 쓰다), whereas 雨傘 우산 protects from precipitation on rainy days (우산을 쓰다).
Direct antonyms for sleeve length. 긴팔 is worn in autumn and winter to retain warmth (긴팔 셔츠 long-sleeved shirt), whereas 반팔 is worn in summer to stay cool (반팔 티셔츠 short-sleeved T-shirt).
Native 소매 meaning garment sleeve (소매를 걷어붙이다 to roll up sleeves) vs Sino-Korean 小賣 retail trade (소매점 retail store, opposite of 도매 wholesale). Unrelated origins.

tx-13.note: Both translate to change, but 거스름돈 is strictly the money returned after a transaction (거스름돈 500원). 잔돈 refers generally to small-denomination coins or loose cash in your pocket (잔돈이 필요하다).
Payment formats. 수표 is a bank-issued promissory paper check used for large payments (십만 원권 수표 bank check), whereas 현금 is liquid currency cash (현금 결제 cash payment).
생활비 covers essential everyday survival costs like rent, groceries, and bills (한 달 생활비). 용돈 is discretionary spending money or personal pocket allowance (아이에게 용돈을 주다).

tx-14.note: Crucial medical and dining antonyms. 식후 indicates taking medication or resting after eating (식후 30분에 드세요), whereas 식전 indicates before eating on an empty stomach (식전에 복용하다).
Both mean sold out, but 매진 is commonly used for tickets, shows, and transit seats (기차표 매진 ticket sell-out). 품절 is standard for manufactured retail merchandise running out of stock (인기 상품 품절).
Direct economic antonyms. 저축 is setting money aside in savings for future security (매달 저축하다), while 소비 is spending money to purchase goods or services (과소비 overspending).

tx-15.note: Symmetrical chronological antonyms from today. 그제 is two days in the past (그제 만났어요 met two days ago), while 모레 (or 낼모레) is two days into the future (모레 시험이에요 exam is day after tomorrow).
Traditional lunar calendar benchmarks. 보름 is the 15th day with a round full moon (정월 대보름, 보름달), while 그믐 is the dark moonless end of the lunar month (그믐달 crescent/last moon).
Native adverb 막 meaning just right now or blindly (막 출발하려던 참 just about to leave) vs Sino-Korean 幕 theatrical act or protective membrane (연극 1막 act one of a play, 각막 cornea).

tx-16.note: The two official calendar systems in Korea. 양력 tracks the solar year for official dates (양력 생일 solar birthday), whereas 음력 tracks lunar cycles for traditional holidays (음력 설날 Lunar New Year).
Exact 12-hour opposites. 정오 is midday when the sun peaks at 12:00 PM (정오에 점심을 먹다), whereas 자정 is deep midnight at 12:00 AM (자정이 넘은 시각 past midnight).
Temporal orientation antonyms. 앞날 looks ahead to future prospects and destiny (앞날을 응원하다 to support one future), while 지난날 reflects back on bygone past days (지난날의 추억 past memories).

tx-17.note: Astronomical solar antonyms. 日出 일출 is the sun rising at dawn (동해 일출 East Sea sunrise), whereas 日沒 일몰 is the sun descending below the horizon at dusk (일몰 명소 sunset attraction).
천둥 is the auditory crashing roar of atmospheric shockwaves (천둥이 치다 thunder rumbles). 번개 is the visual electrical light flash streak across clouds (번개가 번쩍이다 lightning flashes).
Frequently confused native verbs. 빌다 means wishing or pleading earnestly (달을 보며 소원을 빌다 to wish upon the moon). 빌리다 means temporarily borrowing an item (도서관에서 책을 빌리다).

tx-18.note: Direct emotional antonyms. 滿足 만족 is contentment with a result or service (고객 만족 customer satisfaction), while 不滿足 불만족 is dissatisfaction when expectations are unmet (서비스에 대한 불만족).
Two native expressions: 한숨 ① deep exhalation or sigh of worry (안도의 한숨 sigh of relief, 한숨을 쉬다) vs 한숨 ② brief restorative nap or short rest (한숨 푹 자고 나다 to take a good nap).
Choice priority antonyms. 최선 is the ideal top option or giving one utmost best (최선을 다하다 to do one best), while 차선 is the secondary fallback when the best is unavailable (차선책 second-best plan).

tx-19.note: Emotional and visual antonyms. 밉다 expresses dislike or irritation at bad behavior (미운 행동 hateful behavior), whereas 곱다 describes lovely elegance or warm attitude (고운 마음 lovely heart).
Emotional progression opposites. 기대 is hopeful anticipation beforehand (큰 기대를 걸다 have high hopes), while 실망 is the sadness felt when reality falls short (기대가 실망으로 바뀌다).
Both mean wish or hope, but 소원 often carries a strong longing or dramatic wish (소원을 빌다 to make a wish), while 소망 expresses warm, modest personal hopes (행복한 가정이라는 소망).

tx-20.note: Culinary techniques with boiling water. 삶다 boils foods thoroughly until cooked deep to the core (달걀을 삶다). 데치다 briefly blanches vegetables in boiling water for seconds to keep crunch (시금치를 살짝 데치다).
Frequently confused homophones. 식히다 [시키다] means lowering temperature or cooling hot food (뜨거운 국을 식히다). 시키다 means placing a food order or ordering a task (피자를 시키다 to order pizza).
Dietary habits opposites. 偏食 편식 is unbalanced eating of only favorite items (아이의 편식 습관 picky eating), whereas 골고루 먹다 is eating a well-balanced spread of all nutrients.
